description: Interface to the Exquis hex keyboard by Intuitive Instruments: it draws the keyboard on screen, retunes incoming notes to the scale the Exquis is set to, and passes that tuning to other modules

params.text: Steps the writing on the on-screen keys through three states, none, the note's name in the current scale, and the note's two lattice coordinates; the lamp beside it shows which is in use
Steps the tuning table offered to MTS-ESP instruments through three mappings: one Exquis key per MIDI note, one scale degree per MIDI note, and one per white key with the black keys silent

inputs.text: Takes a volt per octave pitch with 0V as middle C, rounds it to the nearest semitone and finds the key of that MIDI note on the Exquis layout

outputs.text: The pitch of that key in the current tuning, in volts where one volt doubles the frequency; the maker's tooltip on this jack gives the module's own description rather than the jack's
Sends the current tuning and scale to the Microtonal Hammond as a stream of numbers rather than as a signal

notes: the scale, the tuning and the key layout are chosen on the Exquis itself; nothing on this panel changes them
the module hunts for an Exquis over MIDI every two seconds and checks the link every five; the lamp at the top of the panel is red while none answers and pale blue once one does
the module claims the MTS-ESP master place when it starts, so instruments that follow MTS-ESP take their tuning from it; the three KEYMAP lamps stay dark if another master holds that place
the hexagons on screen and the tuning figures beside them are drawn rather than built from controls, so no click on them reaches this help
